name: kvn-tui VPN
author: Dmitry Yarikov
description: Native Omarchy controls for kvn-tui, a sing-box VPN client for Arch Linux. Connect profiles, switch routing and regions, monitor live traffic, and control the kill switch from your bar.

barWidget.description: Control kvn-tui from the bar: connect profiles, switch routing and regions, view live traffic, and manage kill switch and auto-connect.
